verdict.rationale: A live llms.txt is confirmed at the root domain (HTTP 200, structured content) making the marketing surface agent-legible, and the sitemap lists product pages an agent could navigate. However, the deeper technical documentation at docs.decagon.ai is login-gated with no llms.txt or markdown mirror, so an agent cannot fully explore Decagon's technical docs autonomously. Missing for 10: public agent-readable technical/API docs, an llms.txt covering docs.decagon.ai, and no login gate blocking crawler/agent access.
